description:
intent=i047 snapshot=s04 branch=hardirq-shared-lock status=complete
finding location=drivers/net/ethernet/korina.c:929-945 confidence=medium conclusion=korina lp->lock is taken with plain spin_lock in three hardirq handlers (526/935/962); a nested same-CPU underflow/overflow IRQ preempting the TX-DMA handler spins forever on the held lock - interrupt-context lockup, medium confidence.
finding location=drivers/tty/serial/m32r_sio.c:570-579 confidence=medium conclusion=m32r_sio up->port.lock is taken plainly by both the hardirq handler (477) and the timer-softirq callback m32r_sio_timeout (577); a same-CPU RX hardirq preempting the softirq holder self-deadlocks - medium-confidence lockup.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/qlogic/qlge/qlge_main.c:672 conclusion=Follow up: enumerate every caller of ql_disable_completion_interrupt/ql_enable_completion_interrupt (660-684) and classify context; any process-context caller with IRQs enabled against the plain hardirq takers at 2502/672 is a reportable defect.
coverage_gap=Cross-indexing matched lock expressions textually and only within the registering file; locks shared across files (exported helpers) or referenced through different expressions/aliases were not correlated.
coverage_gap=Handler-lock extraction resolved in-file definitions for 1112 of 1333 unique hardirq handler names; the remaining 221 handlers (defined in other files, macro-generated, or registered via function pointers) were not examined.
coverage_gap=request_threaded_irq registrations (15 sites) were not split into primary hardirq handler vs thread_fn, so thread-context acquisitions of handler-shared locks were not separately audited.
